audit.adaptation_reason: Source decimal side/diagonal measurements and 83-degree diagonal angle are mutually inconsistent with the exact 33-degree and 38-degree givens. Recomputed the ancillary measurements from the exact angle construction and marked them approximate; retained all objects and labels. Replaced duplicated distractor C:52 with C:58; correct answer A:38 is unchanged.
audit.independent_solution: MR is parallel to NP, and RN is a transversal. Angle RNP equals angle MRN, 38 degrees.
